title: Odell Beckham Jr. 2019 Panini Contenders #20 Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2019 Panini Contenders #20 Football Card features Odell Beckham Jr. of the Cleveland Browns. It is a must-have for any NFL fan or sports trading card collector. The card is part of the 2019 set and manufactured by Panini. 

The card is not autographed and is a sports trading card of the type Trading Card Singles. It is an excellent addition to your collection and is perfect for displaying or trading. Get your hands on this Odell Beckham Jr. card today!
